study: Evidence-driven continuation; original cohorts already exposed
exposure: All prior development and confirmation targets were exposed before this new protocol. Fits/tuning use ORIGINAL DEVELOPMENT ONLY; no new winner is chosen using original confirmation. No independent confirmation is asserted.
grouping: same original independent grouping and folds; case92 chronological forward dates; case67 balanced particle within complete configuration

hypotheses.title: Causal decline-gated dielectric response
hypotheses.equation: VCD=max(0,b0+bP*perm*exp(-c*perm_decline_fraction)+bM*missing_perm), bP>=0,c>=0; the decline is from running past peak only

comparators: training-only imputed/scaled robust linear with identical expanded inputs
fold-refitted fixed HistGradientBoosting using identical expanded inputs
fitting: Group-balanced robust constrained least squares (8 deterministic IRLS iterations). Huber scales fixed before fit:37=5W,53=.025Nm,67=.3 log ratio,71=2million/mL,92=3dB. Model shape selected entirely within outer training partitions using inner whole-group or forward validation. Learned imputation/scales/categorical dictionaries only training data. No identifier predictors.
selection: Select simplest candidate within 2% of minimum new-candidate development error; report strong-comparator gaps and every group. Selection does not admit a law.
stopping: Two material hypotheses required; stop after two cycles without >=2% development gain against the strongest equal-information comparator or stronger identified mechanism. A distinct supported follow-up can use a separately frozen amendment before fitting.
bounds: No microscopic mechanism or industrial intervention benefit inferred solely from regression; calibration and missingness remain declared. Baseline error improvements are retrospective unless independent fresh data admitted.
